```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Opposition to all systems of exploitation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism uses hierarchies of social division such as heteropatriarchy and white supremacy to fracture the unity of the masses and further consolidate power into the hands of the few.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal is the liberation of all people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All struggles against oppression are part of the group's own.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group cannot reduce all forms of struggle to class struggle alone.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group recognizes the need for careful and specific understanding of how systems of exploitation interact.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The working class is most effectively organized by embracing the specificity of groups, whether racial, ethnic, religious, sexual, or otherwise, across lines of difference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Class enemies will continue to attempt to weaponize identity as a means of dividing members of the working class.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Such action can only be remedied through direct attention to the needs and experiences of targeted minority groups rather than ignoring their plight to uphold a mirage of uncomplicated unity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Building a socialist future that liberates everyone will require dismantling more systems of social oppression than capitalism alone.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand for the right to be culturally and politically different.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand that white Anarchists/radicals respect the right to disagree on political questions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Most Black-White coalitions have been organized with the whites truly dominating because of their access to superior resources and by having more political access.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is no democracy without accountability and autonomy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democracy is the means through which popular control is enacted, but it is not reducible to a specific given set of procedures or organizational structures.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democracy's particular features and means must reflect material and social conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for systems that develop strong, active rank-and-file participation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Rejection of systems that entrench and silo power, within DSA and outside it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy for direct member assemblies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy for direct referenda and recall.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy for transparency in leadership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy for proportional representation in elected leadership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy for membership oversight over national bodies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Effective oversight should not imply a narrow strategy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA is strongest when members are empowered to carry out work on a variety of terrains.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"People come to DSA for many reasons, and members should be permitted to pursue and maintain those political projects which are most meaningful to them.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Although the collective resources of the organization are rightfully directed by the broadest relevant membership body, the autonomy and initiative of working groups, committees, and individual members should be cultivated, not discouraged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
